name: @pipeworx/mcp-medical-codes

tools.name: search_icd10
tools.description: Search ICD-10-CM diagnosis/billing codes by keyword or code (keyless, offline source: NLM). E.g. "type 2 diabetes" -> [{code:"E11.9", description:"Type 2 diabetes mellitus without complications"}].

query.description: A condition name or an ICD-10 code fragment.

tools.name: search_loinc
tools.description: Search LOINC codes (lab tests & clinical observations) by keyword (keyless). E.g. "hemoglobin a1c" -> LOINC number + long common name.

tools.name: search_medical_terms
tools.description: Search clinical term lists by keyword (keyless): system = "conditions" (problem/diagnosis names), "procedures" (procedure names), or "drugs" (RxTerms drug display names).

tools.name: search_icd10pcs
tools.description: Search ICD-10-PCS inpatient procedure codes by keyword or code prefix (keyless, offline: CMS FY2026 order file, 79115 billable codes). Diagnoses are search_icd10; PCS is what a hospital bills the procedure itself under. E.g. "hip replacement" -> [{code:"0SR9019", description:"Replacement of Right Hip Joint with Metal Synthetic Substitute, Cemented, Open Approach"}]; "0SR9" returns that whole family.

query.description: Procedure keywords (all words must appear), or an ICD-10-PCS code prefix like "0SR9".

tools.name: get_icd10pcs
tools.description: Look up one exact 7-character ICD-10-PCS code, plus the sibling codes for the same procedure on the same body part (keyless, offline: CMS FY2026). E.g. "0SR9019" -> its title plus the other 0SR9* right-hip-replacement codes, which is how you find the uncemented or ceramic alternative to a code you already have.

siblings.description: Max sibling codes sharing the first 4 characters (same procedure on the same body part) to include (0-100, default 10).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-medical-codes forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the medical-codes pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
